translations.web: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.”
translations.bsb: The LORD will record in the register of the peoples: “This one was born in Zion.” Selah
translations.kjv: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
